name: Rogowski TI Gerber Coil Generator
description: TI Gerber-derived dual-winding Rogowski coil with selectable terminal nets and a bottom series link.
description_full: KiCad 10 dual-winding PCB Rogowski coil using TI reference Top/Bottom trace templates. The 32-position mode has 66 vias; variable counts have 2N+2 vias. Curves are native PCB_ARC tracks, including common-radius 180/90 degree bends. Four SMD pads form aligned front/back pairs. Choose existing PCB nets or enter new names for front pads 1 and 2; those nets also apply to their windings and bottom pads 3 and 4 respectively. Bottom pads 3 and 4 are joined by a copper segment in a dedicated net-tie footprint. Generated items are grouped and the PCB editor focuses on the coil after completion. Dimension and copper-overlap validation is required before generation. Live preview supports wheel zoom, left-button pan and parameter highlighting. See README for limitations.
